# Canonical draft — pre-QA partial-scope review

Status: `unreviewed; evidence-bounded; partial-scope`.

## Abstract

SOURCE_FACT [DOI:10.0000/fixture-a @ p. 2, Table 1]: ligand L1 increased isolated yield from 42% to 78% under the reported conditions.

MODEL_SYNTHESIS: Across the allowlisted studies, L1 appears favorable, but the comparison is limited to a named substrate and catalyst window.

MODEL_HYPOTHESIS: The difference may arise from catalyst speciation and should be tested directly.

UNKNOWN: The by-product in the negative boundary case was not structurally assigned.

NOT_COMPARABLE: docking scores and isolated yields use different endpoints and cannot be ranked together.

Chemical GAP: the current scope does not establish behavior across other catalyst states.

SOURCE_FACT [DOI:10.0000/fixture-d @ p. 3, Figure 2/Table S4]: L1 gave 75% while L2 gave 51%; a second substrate showed little difference.

SOURCE_FACT [DOI:10.0000/fixture-e @ p. 4, Table 2]: an independent repeat gave 73% using the same nominal endpoint.

SOURCE_FACT [DOI:10.0000/fixture-f @ p. 5, Table 3]: L1 did not improve conversion for the hindered substrate and an unidentified by-product was observed.
